description: This file defines classes and functions related to the internal configuration management of Playwright test runner, including classes for full configuration and project internal configuration, as well as utility functions for resolving scripts, reporters, and dependencies.

classes.name: FullConfigInternal
classes.description: Represents the internal full configuration for Playwright test runner, including setup for projects, plugins, web servers, and CLI overrides.

classes.name: FullProjectInternal
classes.description: Represents internal project configuration, including test directory, retries, dependencies, and other project-specific settings.

methods.name: takeFirst
methods.description: Returns the first argument that is not undefined among the provided arguments.

methods.name: pathResolve
methods.description: Resolves a relative path against a base directory.

methods.name: resolveReporters
methods.description: Resolves reporter configurations into an array of reporter descriptions.

methods.name: resolveWorkers
methods.description: Converts a string or number into a number of workers, supporting percentages.

methods.name: resolveProjectDependencies
methods.description: Resolves project dependencies and teardowns, ensuring correctness and uniqueness.

methods.name: toReporters
methods.description: Converts reporter input into an array of reporter descriptions.

methods.name: getProjectId
methods.description: Retrieves the unique project ID assigned internally.
